name: Camp Calumet Resident Camp
description_short: Lutheran overnight camp on Ossipee Lake in Freedom, in one or two week sessions. Cabin groups swim, boat, hike and play games together, campers pick three afternoon activities such as arts, photography, music and drama or field sports, and older campers go on overnight hikes and canoe trips.
special_needs_notes: Weeks 1 and 2 include Camp For Those With Special Needs, a mainstream program for campers 8 to 18 with physical, emotional or developmental challenges, who share cabins with other campers and have dedicated coordinators. Campers must be able to care for themselves with limited help. The camp says it cannot take campers with significant behavioral or emotional difficulties.
